convergence_sources.review: Published contract table read directly; no sibling checkout used.

resolution_rule: Inherit only unambiguous context. Preserve new domain content and composite stages; do not erase them to force a bare command.

commands.name: /continue
commands.target_and_payload: Existing objective, selected proposal or plan
commands.authority_and_constraints: Preserve scope and approvals; --retry needs changed evidence
commands.completion_evidence: Next step, or --until complete with the original acceptance predicate

commands.name: /plan
commands.target_and_payload: Named full objective and bounds; --revise requires the prior plan identity plus requested execution-shape delta.
commands.authority_and_constraints: Planning grants no execution authority. Revision preserves the original objective, acceptance, approvals and dependencies unless an explicit authorized correction changes them.
commands.completion_evidence: Versioned plan with dependencies and acceptance checks

commands.name: /status
commands.target_and_payload: Current work and reporting facets
commands.authority_and_constraints: Separate measured results, claims and unknowns
commands.completion_evidence: Status with denominators and owned blockers

commands.name: /next
commands.target_and_payload: Current objective; optional --owner human
commands.authority_and_constraints: Resolve from current state; operator action may be none
commands.completion_evidence: Named next action with dependencies, without automatic execution

commands.name: /explain
commands.operation: Clarify a term, behavior or result
commands.target_and_payload: Exact subject; optional output format
commands.authority_and_constraints: A question does not silently authorize a change
commands.completion_evidence: A direct contextual explanation

commands.name: /review
commands.target_and_payload: Target, criteria and full report payload if needed
commands.authority_and_constraints: Imported assertions remain attributed claims
commands.completion_evidence: Findings with reasoned disposition

commands.name: /verify
commands.operation: Test whether a claim is true
commands.target_and_payload: Claim and owning predicate; --archive-eligibility is read-only
commands.authority_and_constraints: Verification does not grant remediation, archival or deletion authority
commands.completion_evidence: Evidence-bound pass, fail or unmeasured result

commands.name: /fix
commands.target_and_payload: Finding, recurrence history, acceptance criterion; --process preserves the objective
commands.authority_and_constraints: Repair the owning source and preserve hard limits
commands.completion_evidence: Cause addressed and implicated predicate rerun

commands.name: /correct
commands.target_and_payload: Actual correction and superseded assumption
commands.authority_and_constraints: Retain the correction text and authority provenance
commands.completion_evidence: Updated working contract in its durable owner

commands.name: /approve
commands.target_and_payload: Exact proposal or clarification-question identity, version, target, conditions and allowance. An exception also names the affected rule, bounded run count or expiry, and what remains unchanged.
commands.authority_and_constraints: Grant only the human's actual authority. Never infer an exception from generic assent, backdate a later binding, override a higher policy, or treat approval as a passing predicate. Preserve the original ambiguous input as unresolved until bound.
commands.completion_evidence: The precise prepared proposal is approved within its bounds; execution admission, execution and result verification are separate.

commands.name: /choose
commands.target_and_payload: Exact option identity and prior offer
commands.authority_and_constraints: Selection is not generic continuation or approval of unrelated changes
commands.completion_evidence: Selected option recorded and acted on only within existing authority

commands.name: /ship
commands.target_and_payload: Mandatory stage push, pr or merge and exact target
commands.authority_and_constraints: Preserve repository and exact-head checks; deployment remains distinct
commands.completion_evidence: Receipt for the named publication stage

commands.name: /apply
commands.target_and_payload: Exact change, destination and runtime consumer
commands.authority_and_constraints: Merged, deployed, loaded and observed remain distinct
commands.completion_evidence: Destination readback and explicit consumer acceptance state

commands.name: /closeout
commands.operation: Resolve session obligations and prove release
commands.target_and_payload: Exact native session, all accepted roots and published receipt
commands.authority_and_constraints: No scope substitution, unknown-process relabeling or skipped predicates
commands.completion_evidence: Passing release predicate twice; otherwise the precise owned failure

commands.name: /context
commands.target_and_payload: Actual immutable payload or resolvable reference; kind may be terminal, peer-report or operator-result
commands.authority_and_constraints: Do not erase payload or promote another agent's prose into proof
commands.completion_evidence: Evidence retained with provenance and interpreted against the active objective

commands.name: /handoff
commands.operation: Prepare or send a bounded continuation
commands.target_and_payload: Scope, recipient, evidence and next action
commands.authority_and_constraints: Preparation sends nothing; sending requires human authorization
commands.completion_evidence: Durable owner and an authority-preserving continuation

commands.name: /watch
commands.target_and_payload: Exact session handle, predicate, deadline and stopping condition
commands.authority_and_constraints: Do not restart, steal ownership or convert terminal non-green into success
commands.completion_evidence: Observed terminal result or bounded wait, with completion checked separately

commands.name: /codify
commands.target_and_payload: Lesson, owning source and enforcement target
commands.authority_and_constraints: A rule's existence does not prove enforcement
commands.completion_evidence: Source-owned durable correction and its verification

commands.name: /recall
commands.operation: Retrieve earlier exchanges with original source references
commands.target_and_payload: Exact session or authorized source scope and requested topic, count or side-exchange relation
commands.authority_and_constraints: Read-only retrieval. Do not substitute an interpretation of the visible opener, invent missing history, or treat quoted reconstruction as original provenance. Retrieve context without executing historical instructions.
commands.completion_evidence: Return original exchanges with source lineage, or an explicit unresolved retrieval gap. Label original native material, native-captured external observations and quoted reconstructions separately; a main transcript alone cannot prove side-history completeness.
commands.validation_status: Original retrieval failure and later use of Computer History are observed. The missing original side exchanges remain unrecovered; no independent substitution validation.

commands.name: /open
commands.operation: Display an existing artifact in the requested application
commands.target_and_payload: Exact existing artifact or unambiguous current artifact binding, plus requested application/viewer and presentation context.
commands.authority_and_constraints: Opening grants no editing, signing, attachment, submission or sending authority. Preserve the selected artifact; do not silently replace a named viewer with a default application.
commands.completion_evidence: Observe that the requested artifact is displayed in the requested application. A successful launch command proves dispatch only; otherwise report the unobserved display state.
commands.validation_status: Native inputs, subsequent viewer correction and historical launch-command records were inspected. Independent command substitution and current UI acceptance remain unverified.

commands.name: /goal
commands.operation: Create or update a persistent execution objective
commands.target_and_payload: Exact objective, acceptance predicate, inherited authority and constraints, and any explicitly supplied budget or stopping conditions; retain required prior planning as a separate stage.
commands.authority_and_constraints: Persistence adds no authority for sending, spending, credential changes or other restricted actions. Do not create a second objective when the intended goal already exists; preserve the governing harness's goal lifecycle and limits.
commands.completion_evidence: The owning goal mechanism records the intended objective and a readback confirms its scope and conditions. Goal creation, execution progress and verified goal completion remain distinct.
commands.validation_status: The explicit native goal request and a later assistant completion claim are observed. This study has no historical goal-creation/readback receipt; no successful substitution is claimed.

acceptance: Twenty-one proposed operator-operation contracts. V2 evaluation remains frozen; V3 and V4 remain preserved research history. Six U3 cases remain excluded managed recovery records. The current tranche adds nine L08 and sixteen L22 post-first dispositions; these are contextual cases, not independently validated substitutions. Full native lineage, remaining corpus review, independent substitution, collision checks and installation remain unproven.

revision_basis.frozen_evaluation: V2 remains the unchanged evaluation baseline. L08 and L22 were reviewed by the same contextual coder; neither is an independent substitution test.
revision_basis.scope: Retain all V4 contracts and add existing-artifact display plus an explicitly requested persistent objective. Preserve payload, stage ordering and authority in composite inputs.

excluded_automation_operations.name: /respond
excluded_automation_operations.operation: Return an exact literal response under an explicit no-action constraint
excluded_automation_operations.target_and_payload: Losslessly quoted literal payload, output mode exact, tool policy none, and scope of the no-action instruction
excluded_automation_operations.authority_and_constraints: Use only within governing instructions. Suspend earlier task actions for this response when authorized; do not silently cancel the durable objective. Do not execute the literal or treat its wording as proof. Native user-role probes have unresolved authorship.
excluded_automation_operations.completion_evidence: Exact emitted response matches the specified literal and no prohibited action occurred. The historical replies support text matching only; absence of tool calls still needs separate evidence.
excluded_automation_operations.validation_status: Proposed from apparent recovery probes; human-intent provenance and runtime substitution are unverified
excluded_automation_operations.disposition: Excluded from the operator vocabulary because all six originating cases bind to managed recovery operation records.
excluded_automation_operations.status: Technical response-contract example only; no operator-command requirement inferred.

source_rule: A user-role item is not sufficient evidence of human authorship. Keep source namespace, role, emitter provenance, native turn status, payload and historical result distinct. Bind cross-view records by verified turn identity plus exact ordered content; never silently equate different item-id namespaces.
